data.title: Loading Dock Challenge: Find the Threshold!
data.description: Run controlled trials to test how changing the ramp angle and surface affects the push needed to move your load.

challenges.title: Find the First Moving Force
challenges.brief: Find the smallest push setting that makes the wheel climb. Test carefully -- a larger force works, but is not the answer.
challenges.hint: Start low, then narrow the gap between a force that fails and one that works.
challenges.explainOnSolve: You found the threshold: the first slider step where push becomes greater than gravity plus friction.

challenges.title: Measure the Threshold
challenges.brief: Find the least push that starts this crate moving uphill.
challenges.hint: Use failed tests as evidence. Increase by smaller amounts when you get close.
challenges.explainOnSolve: At the threshold, your push just exceeds the two forces opposing motion: downhill gravity and friction.

challenges.title: Test a Steeper Ramp
challenges.brief: Measure the smallest push that will move the barrel up this steeper ramp.
challenges.hint: A steep ramp sends more of gravity down the ramp, even when friction is low.
challenges.explainOnSolve: The steeper angle raised the threshold because more of the barrel's weight acted downhill.

challenges.title: Test a Rough Surface
challenges.brief: Find the minimum push for this rough-surface setup.
challenges.hint: Both the slope and the rough surface oppose your push.
challenges.explainOnSolve: This threshold includes both downhill gravity and the larger friction force from the rough surface.
